finalText:
I worked all nine open flight-change requests (Q-301 to Q-305 and Q-307 to Q-310). Each change is made, any charge is on the ledger, and each request is resolved with a note to the customer. I left Q-306 alone because it's a cancellation, not a flight change.

I used the bulletin calendar's date of 2026-07-28 to decide which bulletins were in effect. That conflicts with the date I was given for today (2026-10-06). On either date PB-2026-09 and PB-2026-17 give the same results, so I treated the "yesterday" requests as current. Those two are the only ones where the date mattered.

| Request | Change | Charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 Ines (R5201) | → DL542, 6 Aug | $0 | Covered by the Chicago waiver (PB-2026-14), economy. |
| Q-302 Jonah (R5202) | → AA664, 7 Aug | $75 change fee + $35 fare difference | A Boston trip isn't covered by the Chicago waiver, so normal economy rules apply. |
| Q-303 Kim (R5203) | → AA664, 7 Aug | $150 change fee + $25 fare difference | The hurricane waiver (PB-2026-09) expired on 15 Jul and covered travel only through 20 Jul. Basic economy fee is $150 under PB-2026-16, and silver is not exempt. |
| Q-304 Lena (R5204) | → UA90, 9 Aug | $35 fare difference | Gold, so no change fee. The Chicago waiver doesn't waive basic economy fare differences. |
| Q-305 Max (R5205) | → AA216, 8 Aug | $75 change fee + $10 fare difference | He was ticketed on 26 Jul, after the waiver's 24 Jul cutoff. |
| Q-307 Oscar (R5207) | → AA218, 8 Aug | $0 | Platinum, so the amended window (PB-2026-14A) runs through 5 Aug and covers his 5 Aug travel. I did not take the payment he offered. |
| Q-308 Petra (R5208) | → AA662, same day | $75 | Flat same-day fee (PB-2026-12), cheaper than the normal fee plus fare difference. |
| Q-309 Quinn (R5209) | Chicago–Boston leg only → AA1406 | $0 | The Chicago waiver costs her least (PB-2026-17), so it beats the $75 same-day fee. The first flight is unchanged. |
| Q-310 Ravi (R5210) | → AA216, 8 Aug | $75 change fee + $30 fare difference | The waiver allows one free move, and he already used it on 26 Jul. |
